_comment: Our own self-documenting settings manifest (NOT a Duda-imposed format). Each entry describes one config field that core/config readConfig() consumes off data.config.*. Types: string | boolean | number | select. Duda serialises every value as a string; readConfig coerces. Keep keys in sync with core/config WidgetConfig.

fields.label: Job collection
fields.help: Name/id of the Duda job collection to read from.

fields.label: Application page
fields.help: Page slug the Apply Now button links to (?jobID=… is appended).

fields.label: Job details page
fields.help: Page slug for the job title / Read More links (/{detailsPage}/{slug}).

fields.label: Show Job Type filter
fields.help: Top level of the classification tree (jobType).

fields.label: Show Classification filter
fields.help: Middle level of the classification tree (profession / category).

fields.label: Show Sub-Classification filter
fields.help: Leaf level of the classification tree (role / sub-category).

fields.label: Nest sub-filters
fields.help: When on, render role under profession and city under state as nested children; when off, each is a separate flat group.

fields.label: Show Location filter
fields.help: Location facets (state → city) plus the location keyword / proximity input.

fields.label: Radius unit
fields.help: Radius slider unit for proximity search.

fields.label: geocode.maps.co API key
fields.help: Enables address geocoding + proximity/radius search. Empty = location filter degrades to a plain keyword match.

fields.label: Results per page
fields.help: Number of job cards shown per page.

fields.label: Card template
fields.help: 'modern' is the semantic card (article/header/meta rows, styled by tokens). 'classic' keeps the legacy shm* markup for a site whose own CSS targets it.

fields.label: Apply button label
fields.help: Text on the apply link.

fields.label: Read more label
fields.help: Text on the details link.

fields.label: Save job label
fields.help: Shown before a job is saved.

fields.label: Unsave job label
fields.help: Shown once a job is saved.

fields.label: Posted prefix
fields.help: Precedes the relative posted date, e.g. 'Posted 3 days ago'.

fields.label: Empty state message
fields.help: Shown when a search returns nothing.

fields.label: Accent colour
fields.help: Sets --sjr-accent: buttons, icons, the New tag. Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

fields.label: Card header colour
fields.help: Sets --sjr-header-bg. Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

fields.label: Card corner radius
fields.help: Sets --sjr-radius. A bare number is treated as px; a value with a unit (1rem) passes through.
